inv.desc_en:
Bar-Restaurant Business Transfer on Paseo de la Castellana 129 – Madrid

Excellent opportunity on one of Madrid's most exclusive and busy arteries, right on Paseo de la Castellana. Prime area, surrounded by offices, hotels, restaurants, shops, and with a constant flow of customers throughout the day.

Address: Paseo de la Castellana 129, Madrid

Surface area: 130 m²

Rent: €3,000/month

Business Transfer: €100,000

The premises have a bar-restaurant license with operating hours from 06:00 to 02:00 and an authorized capacity for 61 people.

Fully equipped and operational, with an excellent glazed facade, smoke extraction, air conditioning, a fully installed kitchen, and a storage area.

Renovated premises ready to continue operations
Facilities in perfect condition
Established environment with high public footfall
License and equipment operational from day one

A great opportunity to continue a successful business or establish a new brand in one of Madrid's most sought-after locations.

Business Transfer: €115,000 | Rent: €3,000/month.
